title: A Survey of Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Progress and Challenges
best_for_zh: 需要设计或比较推理型检索、重排序与评测的读者。
one_line: An ACL 2026 survey of retrieval tasks where finding evidence depends on an inferential connection, not only semantic similarity.
梳理需要依靠隐含推断关系而非仅靠语义相似度的检索任务、基准与方法。
why: It helps readers separate ordinary semantic retrieval from retrieval that needs multi-step or latent-link reasoning.
inclusion_reason: An ACL 2026 survey that makes inference-dependent retrieval methods and their benchmarks easier to compare.

title: Problem
问题
html: Many retrieval systems rank passages by topical or semantic similarity, but some questions require evidence connected through an unstated inferential link. This ACL 2026 survey defines that setting as reasoning-intensive retrieval and collects the benchmarks, retrieval stages, and open challenges needed to study it. It synthesizes prior work rather than releasing a new retrieval dataset. The key reader question is whether a result is relevant only because it shares words or topic with a query, or because it becomes useful after inference. That boundary matters for evaluation and design: adding more semantically similar passages may not solve a failure when the system must recognize an indirect connection.

许多检索系统主要按主题或语义相似度排序，但有些问题需要先补出问题与证据之间未明说的推断联系，才能找到真正有用的材料。这篇 ACL 2026 综述把这类任务称为推理密集检索，梳理相应的基准、检索环节和研究难点；它汇总既有工作，并不发布新的检索数据集。读者需要判断的关键是：结果之所以相关，究竟只是因为与查询共享词语或主题，还是因为经过推断后才有用。这一边界影响评测和设计：若系统必须识别间接联系，加入更多语义相似段落未必能解决失败。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The central distinction is between “looks related” and “supports the answer after inference.” The survey organizes methods by where reasoning enters the pipeline: benchmark construction, retrieval, or reranking. This lets a reader compare systems that spend computation on query understanding, evidence selection, or final ordering without treating them as the same intervention. Its practical frame is a query, candidate evidence, an inferential connection, and a ranked result. When a system improves, ask which element changed. Did it recover better candidates, make the link between query and evidence clearer, or reorder an existing set more effectively? The answer determines both the likely cost and the evidence needed to support the claim.

核心区别是“看起来相关”和“经过推断后能支撑答案”。论文按推理进入流程的位置组织方法：基准构建、召回或重排序。读者因此可以比较不同系统把计算花在理解问题、挑选证据还是最终排序上，而不会把它们混为同一种改进。它的实用框架由查询、候选证据、推断联系和排序结果构成。系统性能提升时，应问到底改变了哪一项：找到了更好的候选、让查询与证据的联系更清楚，还是更有效地重排现有集合？答案决定了可能的成本，也决定了需要什么证据支持该说法。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature synthesis. Its working object is a query, candidate evidence, an inferential connection between them, and a ranked result. The paper first groups benchmarks by knowledge domain and modality, then classifies methods by where and how they integrate reasoning into retrieval. The resulting map includes retrievers and rerankers as well as the evaluation settings that motivate them. For a cited study, record the query form, the evidence unit, the point at which inference is introduced, and the retrieval metric or downstream measure. This avoids treating a benchmark, a retriever, and a reranker as interchangeable. The survey provides a map of relationships; individual papers remain the source for training details, retrieval budgets, and exact implementations.

这是一篇文献综述，不是一套单独实现。它关注的问题对象包括查询、候选证据、两者之间的推断联系和排序结果。论文先按知识领域与模态整理基准，再按推理在检索流程中出现的位置和方式整理方法，覆盖召回器、重排序器及其评测场景。阅读被引研究时，应记录查询形式、证据单元、推断在哪个环节加入，以及检索指标或下游指标。这样不会把基准、召回器和重排序器当成可互换的对象。本文给出的是关系地图；训练细节、检索预算和精确实现仍应以各篇原始论文为准。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper's evidence is its structured comparison of the existing benchmark and method landscape. Its official abstract makes no claim that one architecture wins everywhere; instead, it emphasizes trade-offs and practical applications. When reading a cited result, keep the domain, modality, retrieval stage, and metric attached to the claim. A reported retrieval gain is informative only if the task really requires the latent connection described by the paper. Check whether candidate evidence is judged by relevance alone, by support for a downstream answer, or by another task-specific rule. Also check whether the improvement is measured before or after reranking. These distinctions prevent an inference-dependent result from being mistaken for an ordinary semantic-retrieval comparison.

论文的证据来自对既有基准和方法版图的结构化整理。官方摘要没有宣称某一种架构处处更好，而是强调取舍与应用条件。阅读被引用的结果时，应把领域、模态、所处流程环节和指标一起保留，不能只看单个分数。一个检索提升只有在任务确实需要本文所说的隐含联系时才有解释力。应检查候选证据是仅按相关性判断、按其是否支持下游答案判断，还是依据其他任务特定规则；还要检查改进发生在重排序前还是后。这些区别可避免把依赖推断的结果误当成普通语义检索比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is a common framework for a fragmented area. Rather than grouping work only by model family, the survey connects benchmark properties with the exact point at which reasoning is inserted into a retrieval pipeline. That comparison makes it easier to see whether a reported gain comes from better candidates, better inference over candidates, or a different task definition. The novelty is a vocabulary for separating interventions that are often blended together in retrieval discussions. It is not a new universal retriever, a shared dataset, or proof that reasoning should be added at every stage. Readers can use the framework to identify what is genuinely new in a primary paper and what remains inherited from its benchmark or pipeline.
贡献在于为分散的研究提供共同框架。它不只按模型种类分组，还把基准性质与推理插入检索流程的具体位置联系起来。这样读者能区分一个提升究竟来自更好的候选集合、更好的候选推断，还是来自不同的任务定义。新意在于提供一种词汇，把检索讨论中常混在一起的改动分开。它不是新的通用召回器、共享数据集，也没有证明每个环节都应加入推理。读者可以用此框架识别原始论文中真正新颖的部分，以及仍然继承自其基准或流程的部分。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Inferential relevance is difficult to define and measure cleanly. A passage can be semantically close but insufficient, while a useful passage can appear distant until combined with other evidence. The survey also aggregates varied domains and modalities, so conclusions from one benchmark should not automatically be generalized to another. Its categories do not remove the need to inspect the original task definition. A system may use language-model inference, structured signals, or reranking, yet the evaluation may still be dominated by topic matching. Results also depend on evidence granularity, corpus coverage, compute budget, and downstream use. Avoid concluding that a method has solved reasoning-intensive retrieval from a single metric without checking these conditions.

推断相关性本身不容易被清楚定义和测量。一段文本可能语义接近却不足以回答问题，也可能要与其他证据结合后才显得有用。综述汇总的领域和模态很多，因此一个基准上的结论不能自动推广到另一个基准。这些类别也不能取代对原始任务定义的检查。一个系统可能使用语言模型推断、结构化信号或重排序，但评测仍可能主要由主题匹配决定。结果还受证据粒度、语料覆盖、计算预算和下游用途影响。不要只凭单一指标就断定某方法解决了推理密集检索，而应先核对这些条件。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a retrieval failure looks like more than a vocabulary mismatch. It is especially helpful before choosing whether to improve a retriever, add inference-aware reranking, or redesign an evaluation set. The taxonomy gives a reader concrete comparison questions: what evidence is needed, where inference occurs, and what trade-off the system accepts. Begin with a failed query and describe the indirect link that a useful result must satisfy. Then locate the likely failure point: candidate generation, reasoning over candidates, or final ordering. The survey helps frame that diagnosis and select comparable studies, but it does not substitute for testing the proposed change on a benchmark whose relevance definition matches the application.

当检索失败不只是词汇不匹配时，可以用这篇论文定位问题。它适合帮助读者决定：应该改进召回、加入面向推断的重排序，还是重新设计评测集。其分类给出三个具体问题：需要什么证据、推断发生在哪里、系统为此接受了什么代价。可以从一次失败查询开始，描述有用结果必须满足的间接联系，再定位最可能的失败点：候选生成、对候选的推断，或最终排序。本文帮助建立诊断框架并寻找可比研究，但不能替代在相关性定义符合应用需求的基准上测试所提修改。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Start with the distinction between semantic similarity and latent inferential links. Then read the benchmark taxonomy before the method taxonomy, because the task determines what counts as useful evidence. For each cited system, note its pipeline position, its evidence units, and whether its evaluation truly requires inference. Ask what would make a topically similar result insufficient and what combination of information would make a less obvious result useful. Record the metric and whether it is computed on initial retrieval, reranking, or downstream performance. This reading discipline keeps the survey's categories connected to concrete retrieval decisions and prevents broad claims from outrunning the evidence in the primary study.
先抓住语义相似与隐含推断联系的区别，再读基准分类，最后读方法分类；因为任务决定了什么证据算有用。阅读每个被引用系统时，记录它位于流程的哪一步、处理什么证据单元，以及评测是否真的需要推断。应追问：为什么主题相近的结果仍然不足？哪些信息组合会使不那么显眼的结果变得有用？记录指标，以及它在初始召回、重排序还是下游表现上计算。这样的阅读纪律把本文分类与具体检索决策相连，也防止宽泛主张超出原始研究证据。
